name: Pullman Dakar Teranga
desc: Overlooking Dakar Bay, Pullman Dakar Teranga is a 5-star hotel with 247 contemporary rooms and suites, offering beautiful views of the Atlantic Ocean and Gorée Island. From the Junction by Pullman lobby to the meeting spaces and the restaurant with its panoramic terrace, every area blends elegance, comfort and modernity. Guests also enjoy free WiFi up to 300 MB, plus the pool, spa and fitness room.
address: 10,  Rue Colbert, Place de L' independance, 10200

name: Novotel Dakar
desc: Enjoy a dream stay at the Novotel Dakar, a four-star hotel located in the city center, on the Corniche in front of the island of Gorée. Our 241 bedrooms are all equipped with free WiFi, safe, minibar, air conditioning and a flat screen TV. Organize your events in our 11 meeting rooms. The hotel has a restaurant, bar lounge, outdoor terrace with pool views and free private car park.

name: Ibis Styles Dakar
desc: Welcome to the Ibis Styles Dakar, a design hotel in the heart of the Senegalese capital. Immerse yourself in an artistic and colorful atmosphere thanks to its 106 modern rooms, perfect for combining creativity and relaxation. Ideally located, the hotel facilitates access to must-see sites such as the Kermel craft market, art galleries, museums, and Gorée Island. Enjoy a generous local breakfast! Ibis Styles Dakar…
address: Avenue Abdoulaye Fadiga, Avenue Abdoulaye Fadiga, 18524

name: Mövenpick Resort Lamantin Saly
desc: 80 km south of Dakar, on the coast of West Africa's largest seaside resort, lies a tropical haven with 186 rooms and suites, where traditional charm meets modern comfort. New! Discover our luxurious floating rooms, complete with a home cinema and a terrace with breathtaking ocean views. Adventure seekers can enjoy fishing, canoeing through the mangroves and safaris in Bandia.
